semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Append-only tenant-scoped quantity and value fact with source, warehouse, item, time, idempotency and costing snapshot.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP movement models connect physical operations with valuation and later accounting.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Corrections use explicit reversal or adjustment facts; history is never overwritten.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Versioned effective strategy resolved by legal entity and operational location before each movement.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics and Odoo support multiple costing methods at governed product scopes.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: AVG and FIFO are evidenced; a new method requires a universal strategy, migration rules and E2E valuation proof.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Reproducible quantity-times-cost position whose detail reconciles movements, layers and Ledger handoff at a cutoff.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo separates operational stock valuation from accounting recognition and Dynamics uses inventory close for periodic methods.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Inventory calculates cost facts; Ledger decides and records balanced entries through semantic account roles.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Approved value adjustment for obsolescence, damage or lower net realizable value, preserving quantity and original cost history.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Inventory reporting and accounting controls distinguish valuation losses from normal issue costing.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Use an auditable adjustment and Ledger handoff; never call it depreciation or silently replace unit cost.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Allocation that reduces ATP without moving physical quantity or consuming cost.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP and Dynamics separate availability commitment from physical issue.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Reservation cannot create a stock movement or COGS until fulfillment.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Items held for sale or consumption remain inventory; capitalized durable goods transfer to Fixed Assets through an approved business event.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP suites separate inventory valuation from asset depreciation subledgers.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Inventory is written down or consumed; only Fixed Assets runs depreciation after capitalization.

northStar.bestVersion: A cross-industry inventory engine where every quantity, reservation, layer, unit cost and valuation is reproducible by item and location, configurable by policy, traceable to its source and reconcilable with accounting across organizations.
businessOutcomes: Expose reliable on-hand, reserved, ATP, aging and value at any cutoff.
Cost retail, restaurant, beauty, hotel and manufacturing flows with one governed strategy framework.
Explain purchase cost, landed cost, consumption, variance, write-down and Ledger effect without country or customer forks.
invariants: Movement history is append-only and idempotent.
Reservation changes ATP without moving quantity or cost.
Quantity, value and cost layers reconcile for every item-location scope.
Inventory emits semantic valuation facts and never embeds concrete Ledger accounts.
Write-down and obsolescence preserve original facts and require approval.
Inventory is not depreciated; capitalization hands ownership to Fixed Assets.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Costing method, effective scope, movement behavior, negative-stock policy, tracking, replenishment, landed-cost allocation, NRV/obsolescence policy, tolerances and semantic account roles are versioned Control Plane data; code owns universal inventory primitives and strategy interfaces.

lessons.observedCapability: Movement types govern quantity, value and account-grouping consequences.
lessons.lesson: Operational movement semantics and financial effects need one governed vocabulary.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep append-only universal movements with configured behavior and semantic account roles.

lessons.observedCapability: FIFO, weighted average and standard cost interact with settlement, period close and purchase-price variances.
lessons.lesson: A costing method is a lifecycle with close, adjustment and variance behavior, not just a formula.
lessons.ubpDecision: Require strategy, effective scope, layer/settlement evidence, migration and Ledger reconciliation before activating each method.

lessons.observedCapability: Stock movements retain valuation under AVCO/FIFO while standard price and corrections follow distinct rules.
lessons.lesson: Physical movement, valuation fact and accounting entry must remain traceable but independently controlled.
lessons.ubpDecision: Persist the costing snapshot and correction fact on movement, then hand semantic value effects to Ledger.

lessons.observedCapability: Operational execution spans bins, lots, receipts, counts, material queues and WIP.
lessons.lesson: Industry breadth depends on a common location and traceability core.
lessons.ubpDecision: Layer vertical workflows over shared item, warehouse, lot, serial, movement and costing primitives.
